definitions.explanation: Two things that go together as a matching set.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対|つい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: These vases are sold as a pair.

examples.japanese: {対|つい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't find the matching sock.

examples.japanese: {対|つい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{屏風|びょうぶ}→屏風：06228_byoubu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I displayed the pair of folding screens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対|つい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無|な}くして→無くす：01110_nakusu⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I lost one of the matching pair of earrings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対|つい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: These dolls are a male-female pair, used as wedding decorations.

notes:
{対|つい} refers to two things that form a matching pair or set. It's different from ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ (two items) because it emphasizes that the items belong together.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対|つい}で: as a pair, in pairs
- {対|つい}の～: a pair of ~
- {対|つい}になる: to form a pair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ペア→ペア：11265_pea⟧: pair (loanword, often for people)
- ⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧: set, pair (also for people/things working together)
- ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧: twins

NOTE: As a prefix, {対|たい}～ means 'versus' or 'against' (e.g., {対|たい}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ = versus Japan).
